[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.tags: doublestar glob; ref filter refs/tags/<pattern> (pattern !v*-rc* has a different meaning in doublestar than in the source; it is written as is; the tag name filter is written as a ref filter on the tag event)
